_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a global biopharmaceutical company whose mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases.' (FY2012 10-K, Item 7); 'We face intense competition from other biopharmaceutical manufacturers, including for both innovative medicines and lower-priced generic products.' (Item 1A heading); 'It is possible that we may lose market exclusivity of a product earlier than expected.' (Item 1A heading); 'We depend on certain key products for most of our net sales, cash flows and earnings.' (Item 1A heading)

BEAR.desc: EPS -65.2%/yr (worst year FY03-FY12, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-4.2%/yr (FY13 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +-3.0%/yr (FY03-FY12 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +83.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY12); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2013-03-01) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 5.84x (91.9% downside to Bear $3 / +15.7% upside to Bull $43) | Adj composite 1.97 vs market 2.37: gap -0.40 [MODESTLY OVERVALUED] | +30% above the EPP floor $29 (18x FY13E $1.59) | Conservative 2-yr case: -10.9% total (-5.5%/yr) | At 23.4x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $49 sits above the BULL case; U.S. revenues -37.9% in Q4 2012, forward revenues -8.1% to -3.5% (FY13 sales guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
